summary: Backend regression re-run after defensive edits to analytics.py (profile init before rules branch) and research.py (f=None before CSV try). All 18 pytest tests in test_api_integration.py passed in 14.62s against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. The targeted scenarios — /api/research/import (invalid CSV -> 422, valid CSV -> 202 {status:running, rows:N}), session analysis path (POST /api/sessions with synthesized WAV, review, PDF report) and /api/health — all behave correctly. Temp test users and their artefacts were purged with scripts/cleanup_test_data.py.
critical_code_review_comments: research.py import_csv: 'f=None' init is safe but 'f' is still referenced inside the try before validation finishes; current logic is fine because an unreadable CSV short-circuits to 422. The bare 'except Exception' swallows unexpected traces — consider logging before converting to 422 for easier debugging.

analytics.py analyze(): The pre-init of profile='Lanjutkan eksplorasi' is correctly defensive. However the comparisons m['wer']>20 and m['wpm']<60 can still raise TypeError if speech is true but WER/WPM happen to be None (shouldn't occur with current align() but worth guarding).
server.py / modules: Several files pack multiple statements per line (e.g. analytics.py, research.py). Readability-wise it would be worth splitting; not a functional issue.
test_credentials: Suite creates ephemeral test.*@example.com accounts; cleaned up after run. Demo accounts guru@cortexia.id / siswa@cortexia.id (Cortexia123) left untouched.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. scripts/cleanup_test_data.py removed 3 temp users and related game/practice docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend remains 18/18 green after the two defensive initializations. Frontend was not retested in this iteration (backend-only request). If future changes touch analytics.analyze() rule branch or research.import_csv validation, re-run test_api_integration.py and verify both /api/research/import (bad=422, good=202) and session create/review/report flow.
